Vanderhoof Sports & Wellness Institute is your Bay Area chiropractor committed to providing the highest standard of multidisciplinary health care to the community while educating individuals on how to take care of their own health needs outside of our facility.

Dr. Aaron holds a certification in Cold Light Laser Therapy, trained in Active Release Technique (ART®), and specializes in extremity adjustment. He is also an expert in Biomechanic and Ergonomic evaluations, care for pre- and post-natal women, and sports therapy rehabilitation. Other services include: Kinesio Taping, Graston Technique, Physiotherapy, Deep Tissue Massage, Nutrition, Cupping, and Power Plate.  

Whether you are seeking treatment for major/minor ailments or would like to simply sustain your current level of wellness, we are driven to help you comfortably and effectively manage almost any musculoskeletal complaints or ailments.
